← AskA0 · Watcher · automation

Parse watches the accounts. You read the stories.

The watcher visits every account in the registry that posts about Kosovo, keeps the new posts, groups them into stories, and runs the Tracer on each story as it grows: where it started, how it spread, who amplified it, how urgent it is. A story that reaches P1/P2 raises an alert. Replay runs an archived window in time order as if it were live, which is the back-test the brief asks for.
